q01_sample.run_id: 32 lowercase hex digits; distinct for frontend pilot, signal pilot and final matrix

entrypoint.inner_cli_limit: Only inside existing guarded invoke_native scope; invoking it directly does not establish scope or serial ownership.
entrypoint.bounds: One child at a time, 120-second target timeout, unchanged 24 GiB scope / 36 GiB host guard; 32-row legacy preflight precedes each cell and is unmeasured.

per_phase: Successful receipt from exact revision, clean tracked sources and exact worktree path
Full streamed runner SHA plus size, mtime, ctime, inode and device match; unchanged after sample
Same frozen generator/dependency/helper/protocol and source-design hashes; matching workload/schema/fixture/settings hashes for each pair
Record UDF, Python, inherited environment, affinity and kernel bindings; compare identical metric scope and guard evidence
receipt_requirements.lookup: invoke_native uses existing automatic receipt lookup: verification/build-receipts/{revision}-{sha256(resolved_worktree)[:16]}.json. The inner parser additionally supports --build-receipt {path}; invoke_native does not forward that override.
receipt_requirements.missing_or_stale_receipt: Stop that phase before any target; no reuse of a receipt from another path or commit; no build is part of this manifest.

family_reconciliation.rows_collectors: Original COUNT plus machine-integer SUM family, ROWS frame
family_reconciliation.range_mixed: Original RANGE MIN/MAX plus supported collectors family; co-location currently unproved and source-shape correction required
family_reconciliation.range_collectors: Required collector-only constituent of range_mixed; supplements the original four families, not a fifth new acceptance claim

preconditions: Both exact executable receipts available; no concurrent build/native job

frontend_smoke.purpose: Check frontend typing, setup capacity, ordered row semantics and actual physical shapes; never treated as performance acceptance.

signal_probe.rows: largest N at current ladder level
signal_probe.selection: Choose a single ladder level before final matrix freeze. Do not tune tolerances, omit failures, or retain selected fast samples.
signal_probe.prerequisite: Use the shared named-window correction and matched setup control first; bind the corrected generator and freeze the same source for the later matrix. Old split-window observations cannot select an accepted matrix.

pilot.startup_and_setup: CPU includes runner startup, fixture parsing/loading, compilation and target. At fixed N compare widths using identical setup. Report matched cheap-scan control separately once prepared; the 32-row legacy preflight is not that control. No operator CPU decomposition or startup-RSS subtraction exists.
pilot.signal_limit: If common setup masks baseline width sensitivity, or the unchanged proposed signal/noise checks are inconclusive, remain pending. Row-growth can be dominated by setup and does not isolate the window runtime.

later_matrix.row_counts: the three N values of the frozen ladder level
later_matrix.primary_cells: At each N use W=16 and W=512; add W=128 at largest N: 7 cells x 4 families = 28.
later_matrix.constituents: range_minmax at W=512 already occurs at all three N; add only range_collectors W=512 at each N: 3 additional cells.
later_matrix.warmup: One labeled excluded warmup per revision/(family,N,W) profile, index 0: 62 warmup children.
later_matrix.measurement: Five paired attempts per profile, indices 0..4: 310 measured children; preserve every failed/inconclusive attempt.
later_matrix.order: Serial profiles in declared family order, ascending N then W; alternate pair order by (profile ordinal + repetition) parity: baseline/fixed then fixed/baseline. No parallel pairs.
later_matrix.count_limit: 372 database children plus one separate preflight each, before missing controls or pilots. This is planning arithmetic, not executed evidence.

prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.required: Use one explicitly named window for all aggregate calls in each recipe. Current repeated inline clauses get fresh frontend names; new RBO emits one window operator per name. This can defeat the intended combined MIN/MAX and mixed collector path.
prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.small_change: A local generator builder emitting shared OVER-name references and one WINDOW definition; same schema, fixture, frame parameters and row oracle. No production or measurement-helper edit.
prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.evidence: Require a dataflow witness for the actual mixed MIN/MAX-plus-collector pipeline; global callable counts alone cannot prove co-location.

prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.required: Same schema_and_seeds(N, case), settings and input identity; cheap ordered id projection instead of windows.
prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.small_change: Add one explicit setup-scan case to the same scaling generator with minmax=false and collectors=false; reuse current row oracle and guarded one-cell API. Bind its own query hash and compare same-N control CPU separately.
prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.limit: The control still includes its scan/output/compilation; subtracting it does not prove exact operator CPU. No control is included in the frozen reviewed patch.

prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.required: At largest N add one suffix and one unsupported-aggregate fallback control for each MIN/MAX-bearing family (rows_minmax, range_minmax, range_mixed); keep their semantics/resource non-regression separate from supported-work speedup.
prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.status: Six control profiles proposed, generator/oracle/path contracts still needed; excluded from the 31-profile count.

prerequisites_and_narrow_followups.required: Separate actual MiniKQL allocation/absolute-peak lane, exact physical-path evidence and independently reviewed closed resource validator; none is supplied by whole-child CPU/RSS.

frontend_and_type_review.status: source-compatible basic types/bounds; no native parser/type check performed
findings: Small nonnegative frame literals fit the frontend Int32 bound contract; RANGE has exactly one required Int64 order key and uses numeric offsets.
Nullable bounded Int64 values fit fixed CanUsePrefixSum and admitted scalar MIN/MAX; the deterministic value range avoids accumulator overflow at every permitted N.

Per-partition ids are spaced by three, so RANGE width counts key distance; it admits roughly width/3 prior rows, whereas ROWS counts positions. Compare widths within a family, not equal-width row cardinalities across ROWS/RANGE.
Repeated inline window identities are the concrete shape blocker described above; actual lowering must be inspected after named-window correction.

One fixture statement contains N combined SELECT arms. Its frontend/type/compile cost and potential depth/size limits may dominate or fail the pilot; do not raise timeout/memory/output limits or reinterpret setup failure as an optimizer regression.
Existing 16 MiB result/AST limits remain fail-closed; large-N result serialization and final ordering still require native validation.
